tagline: Think through your goals, out loud.
brand_voice: Precise, curious, rigorous, and direct. The honest coach is harder to like but easier to trust. Zero slop, zero cheerleading, zero fluff.

theme_strategy.aesthetic: Monochromatic architectural density with sharp hairline grids, high-contrast monospace accents, tactical state indicators, and pure utilitarian focus.

layout_structure.header: Fixed top bar with logo, tagline, model provider switcher, storyboard selector, honesty audit toggle, and theme switch (z-50, backdrop-blur-md bg-opacity-80).
layout_structure.chat_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col h-full border-r border-border bg-background relative
layout_structure.dashboard_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto bg-card/40 p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-6
layout_structure.mobile_behavior: Tabbed or stacked layout allowing full access to both Chat and Tracking Dashboard on smaller viewports.

key_components.name: Header & Nav
key_components.description: Top navbar displaying brand 'GoalCoach', literal tagline 'Think through your goals, out loud.', Model Provider dropdown (Gemini default, Claude, OpenAI), Storyboard Moment picker, and Google Auth trigger.

key_components.name: Chat Console (Primary Surface)
key_components.description: High-density streaming chat view with message timeline, markdown renderer, model voice tag, and text area with key submit.

key_components.name: Inline Tool Proposal Prompts (MCP-Style State Writers)
key_components.description: Injected directly into chat stream whenever the LLM proposes creating, updating, or dropping goals or commitments. Contains clear diff view + Confirm and Reject buttons.

key_components.name: Tracking Dashboard (Readable View of State)
key_components.description: Live state representation of active goals grouped by time horizons (Immediate/Weekly, Medium-term, Long-term), with over-commitment indicator alert banner.

key_components.name: Over-Commitment Warning Widget
key_components.description: Calculates active load vs capacity and surfaces bold tactical warning when commitments exceed sustainable threshold.

key_components.name: Honesty Audit Log
key_components.description: Audit trail log modal/view showing history of coach commitments, state mutations, dates, tool calls, and exportable JSON/CSV capability.

key_components.name: Storyboard Moments Selector
key_components.description: Quick switcher to load pre-built scenario states: Cold start multiple goals, Cold start one goal, Cold start over-committed, Returning after a gap, Long-term user meta question, Routine return.

key_components.name: Google Login View
key_components.description: Minimal single-sign-on screen with single Google button and explicit data privacy promise.

key_components.name: Onboarding Paragraph Block
key_components.description: One-paragraph plain explanation of the coach's mechanics, memory, and state writer paradigm.

accessibility_requirements.keyboard_navigation: Full tab ordering, enter/space trigger on actionable items, clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-sky-500 ring-offset-2).
accessibility_requirements.screen_reader: Aria-live='polite' on streaming chat responses, role='log' on chat thread, role='status' on over-commitment indicators.
accessibility_requirements.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with motion-reduce or respect CSS prefers-reduced-motion media query.
accessibility_requirements.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, modals, state badges, and message containers MUST include clear kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the literal tagline 'Think through your goals, out loud.' is displayed in the main header and onboarding banner.
The coach response output shape MUST adhere to: 1-paragraph synthesis + <=3 weekly actions + 1 over-commitment warning when applicable.
The LLM cannot modify goal state silently. Any tool call proposal MUST present an inline prompt in the chat for user confirmation.
Ensure exact synchronization between chat state changes (upon user confirmation) and the tracking dashboard view.
Never add unnecessary marketing gradients or fluffy motivational text — uphold the rigorous, direct, honest voice of GoalCoach.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts, bubbly gradients, and emoji assistant icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 1px solid hairline borders with clean padding (p-4 to p-6) to give structure density.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Smooth transition states on buttons, clear active states on model switcher tabs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner for instant feedback on tool confirmations and data exports.
